payout_quote: We'll Start You Off With $300 when you open a new checking account at GPB! ... To qualify for your $300 bonus, simply meet one of the following requirements: 1. Set Up Direct Deposit: Have $500 or more deposited into your account. OR 2. Maintain a Balance: Keep an average balance of $2,500. ... After you meet the first requirement, just tackle two of these easy tasks: Make 20 Debit Card Transactions ... Online Bill Payments: ... 3 online bill pays or ACH payments. Enroll in eStatements.
steps: Open a new Great Plains Bank checking account at https://www.gpbankok.com/checking-campaign (OK & TX; no GPB consumer checking in the last 12 months).
Within 90 days: set up $500+ in direct deposits OR maintain a $2,500 average balance, AND complete two of: 20 debit card transactions, 3 online bill pay/ACH payments, or eStatements enrollment.
The $300 bonus is deposited into the new account within 60 calendar days after all requirements are met; keep the account open and in good standing.
catches: OK & TX only; limited to individuals who have not owned or co-owned a Great Plains Bank consumer checking account within the last 12 months.
Within 90 days: (1) $500+ direct deposit OR $2,500 average balance, AND (2) two of: 20 debit card transactions, 3 bill pay/ACH payments, or eStatements enrollment.
One bonus per account and per customer; cannot be combined with other checking offers.
Bonus deposited within 60 calendar days after all requirements are met; account must be open and in good standing when paid.
Bonus may be reported to the IRS as interest income on Form 1099-INT; offer valid through 12/31/2026, subject to change.
biggest_catch: Oklahoma/Texas only, and you must stack two layers of requirements within 90 days: $500 direct deposit (or $2,500 average balance) PLUS two of three extra tasks.
eligibility: OK & TX; individuals who have not owned or co-owned a Great Plains Bank consumer checking account in the last 12 months; one bonus per account and per customer.
timing: Bonus deposited within 60 calendar days after all requirements are met.

maximize: Fastest honest path. The gating item is almost always your payroll cycle. Fastest honest path: open online today and switch a real payroll/government direct deposit immediately — employer payroll changes take 1–2 pay cycles, so start now; Zelle, bank-to-bank transfers, and microdeposits usually don't count as direct deposit. After the qualifying deposits post, the bank's payout window is fixed and nothing speeds it up.
